note: A grass pull-in off Bark Road, 0.14 mile from Betsey Road and in sight of the road; the agency says it holds 'one small camper trailer or one vehicle with tents', and lists the site as 50 by 40 ft. It lies under hardwood canopy and no clearing shows on imagery, so the size of the pad is not confirmed. Grass, so soft after rain. Bark Road is a forest road off Betsey Road, about 2 miles from Pleasant Valley Road near the US 30 / I-70 junction east of Breezewood. Pack out trash. State forest roads are not plowed in winter. --Claude
